note: Verified in CI by leanprover/comparator v4.33.0 (commit 3927ad383f208ae977c340a91c48ac9b497d2097), built from this project as a Lake dependency with leanprover/lean4:v4.33.0, .github/workflows/ci.yml, against eric-vergo/HopfProblem at commit e0c4c90437dec6209f8922c26e1cf0aadfc0627b: the Solution module kernel-checks the exact Challenge statement Mathoverflow1973.mathoverflow_1973, using only the permitted axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.
